lines.text: Some in Corinth say there is no resurrection of the dead, but if Christ has not been raised, preaching and faith are worthless.
If the dead are not raised, Paul and the others are false witnesses about God, and the Corinthians are still in their sins.
Christ has been raised as the firstfruits, and as in Moses all die, so in Christ all will be made alive.
Christ hands the kingdom to God the Father, and the last enemy He destroys is sin.
Paul says he faces death every day and that he fought wild beasts in Ephesus.
